4477-5929-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4477-5929-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Leyline of Transformation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-4885-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-4885-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

2023-3755-4770-7297.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-2506-3249--52.easyPrerequisites:
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
The creature castable for one mana has the creature type chosen with Molten Echoes.
728-2033-2506-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Molten Echoes triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-6248-6723--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-6248-6723--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from A Realm Reborn by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Phenomenon Investigators triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

1479-2443-2638-2841.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2638-2841.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Tracker and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Tracker trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Tracker triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-2415-2511-6634.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

967-2438-5220-7855--180.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the Goblin, Orc or Army.
967-2438-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat

4871-5220-6797-7806.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-6797-7806.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

3263-4186-6830-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3263-4186-6830-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3291-3457-7791.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Seeker of Skybreak by tapping it, targeting Karametra's Acolyte.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Seeker of Skybreak's ability, targeting Seeker of Skybreak.
Resolve both Seeker of Skybreak abilities, untapping it and Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat.

1478-2092-2757-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Sakura-Tribe Elder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Sakura-Tribe Elder, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Elder by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

80-796-1618-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Poppet Stitcher
80-796-1618-2440.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Venture Forth.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Poppet Stitcher triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Venture Forth.
Repeat.
80-796-1618-2440.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Poppet Stitcher. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

6026-6798-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
6026-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Field of Souls and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

914-3036-4742.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-4742.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

2034-3000-4017-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-3000-4017-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4331-4993-5060.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1805-4331-4993-5060.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0} due to Cemetery Prowler.
Repeat.

141-2511-3047.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from step 5.

1069-1374-5499-6968--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-5499-6968--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

3693-4772-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Walking Ballista triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Doubling Season.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
3693-4772-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

2425-4050-5544-6822.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Forsaken Miner, adding {B}.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, targeting a creature an opponent controls.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Forsaken Miner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Lyla trigger.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a charge counter on it

3609-3750-6702.easyPrerequisites: You have a repeatable way to allow Kilo to tap.
3609-3750-6702.description:
Tap Kilo by any method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and put a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phsae after this one.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time. Then, repeat steps 1 and 2 one additional time.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
3609-3750-6702.notes: You can use any method(s) to tap Kilo three times per turn. If those methods have additional costs (such as life payments, mana, etc.), then you must pay those costs three times as well.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

4543-4872-6333-6678.manaNeeded: {4} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
4543-4872-6333-6678.description:
Cast Time Warp from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Talon Gates of Madara by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

1987-2468-2751-5034.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Sol Ring and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3228-4359-5477.description:
Activate Mobilization by paying {2}{W}, creating three 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate the Soldiers by tapping them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.

1365-4779-4853-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-4779-4853-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

3391-4214-4871-6019.description:
Activate Korozda Guildmage's second ability by paying {2}{B}{G} and sacrificing Scourge of Nel Toth.
When Scourge of Nel Toth dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Korozda Guildmage ability, creating six 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding one mana of any color.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}{B}{G}.
Cast Scourge of Nel Toth from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

2034-3707-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Tithe Taker, adding {C}{C}.
When Tithe Taker dies, its afterlife ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Tithe Taker trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Tithe Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

643-751-2972.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it and Ganax trigger.
Resolve the Shireking Drake trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2145-3176.description:
Whenever an opponent casts their first spell each turn, Erayo's Essence triggers, countering that spell.
Because Archon of Emeria prevents players from casting more than one spell each turn, opponents cannot cast any more spells this turn.

3615-3624-4050-4999.description:
Cast Flourishing Fox from your graveyard by paying {W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Flourishing Fox, adding {W}.
Flourishing Fox is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Humility removing Flourishing Fox's cycling ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

413-598-2452.notablePrerequisites: You have a Zombie card in hand or in your graveyard.
413-598-2452.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast a Zombie from your hand or graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When the Zombie enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Zombie
Repeat from step 2.

3035-4050-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Nadier.
Nadier leaves the battlefield, creating a number of 1/1 Elf Warrior creature tokens equal to its power.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Elf Warrior tokens, adding {3}.
The tokens leave the battlefield, triggering Nadier's first ability three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on Nadier.
Repeat.
